mapper.insert: INSERT INTO candidate_evaluations ( candidate_id, calculation_version, all_returnable, deadline_at, golden_margin_minutes, average_return_minutes, fairness_gap_minutes, fairness_score, rule_score, recommendation_rank ) VALUES ( #{candidateId}, #{calculationVersion}, #{allReturnable}, #{deadlineAt}, #{goldenMarginMinutes}, #{averageReturnMinutes}, #{fairnessGapMinutes}, #{fairnessScore}, #{ruleScore}, #{recommendationRank} )
mapper.update: UPDATE candidate_evaluations SET calculation_version = #{calculationVersion}, all_returnable = #{allReturnable}, deadline_at = #{deadlineAt}, golden_margin_minutes = #{goldenMarginMinutes}, average_return_minutes = #{averageReturnMinutes}, fairness_gap_minutes = #{fairnessGapMinutes}, fairness_score = #{fairnessScore}, rule_score = #{ruleScore}, recommendation_rank = #{recommendationRank}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE candidate_id = #{candidateId}
UPDATE candidate_evaluations SET recommendation_rank = #{recommendationRank}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE candidate_id = #{candidateId}
mapper.select: SELECT ce.* FROM candidate_evaluations ce JOIN meeting_candidates mc ON ce.candidate_id = mc.candidate_id WHERE mc.meeting_id = #{meetingId} ORDER BY ce.recommendation_rank ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT ce.* FROM candidate_evaluations ce JOIN meeting_candidates mc ON ce.candidate_id = mc.candidate_id WHERE mc.meeting_id = #{meetingId} ORDER BY ce.recommendation_rank ASC
